set.body: When an optimizer, objective evaluation, or provider error occurs after linear work begins, retain the work performed so far, executed levels, best selection checkpoint, and final valid transform in typed Flashalign failure diagnostics. Add deliberate JVM and Scala.js regression cases and ensure PairBenchmarkRunner schema 1.1 failure rows preserve this evidence with result null. Keep the one-audit-after-selection rule and frozen preset thresholds unchanged.
set.title: FA-L27: Preserve evidence for exceptional optimizer and evaluation failures
